settings.language.title: Settings: label of the Language picker.
settings.language.system: Settings > Language: the first option, follow the device's language.
codeblock.copy: Chat code block header row, and the full screen code view's top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the code).
codeblock.copied: Chat and full screen views: label a copy icon button takes for 1.5 s after copying, shown as a checkmark (status, past participle: the text was copied).
codeblock.expand: Chat code block header row: accessibility label and tooltip of the expand icon button that opens the code full screen (verb, command).
codeblock.wrap: Full screen code view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of a toggle icon; on, long lines wrap; off, they scroll sideways (verb phrase, command).
codeblock.untitled: Chat code block header row, shown in place of the language name when the code names none; also the full screen code view's name for screen readers (noun: program code).
table.copy: Full screen table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the table as Markdown text).
table.expand: Chat, above a table wider than the message: accessibility label and tooltip of the expand icon button that opens the table full screen (verb, command).
table.fullscreen_title: Full screen table view: its name for screen readers (noun: a data table).
fullscreen.close: Full screen code or table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the close icon button (verb, command).
host_down.device_offline.title: Offline panel (this device has no network, so no Host can answer), title (heading) when this phone or computer has no network at all.
host_down.device_offline.body: Offline panel (this device has no network, so no Host can answer), one plain sentence under the title, when this phone or computer has no network at all. Clarp is the product name, never translated.
host_down.auth_expired.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the Host refused this device: it must be paired (signed in) again. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.auth_expired.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the Host refused this device: it must be paired (signed in) again. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.wrong_address.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when something else answers at the Host's saved address. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.wrong_address.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when something else answers at the Host's saved address.
host_down.server_stopped.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the computer answers but the Clarp program on it is not running. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.server_stopped.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the computer answers but the Clarp program on it is not running. Clarp is the product name, never translated.
host_down.tailscale_off.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when Tailscale (the private network) seems off on this device. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.tailscale_off.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when Tailscale (the private network) seems off on this device. Tailscale is a product name, never translated.
host_down.host_asleep.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the computer seems switched off or asleep. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.host_asleep.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the computer seems switched off or asleep.
host_down.unknown.title: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), title (heading) when the reason is unknown. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.unknown.body: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), one plain sentence under the title, when the reason is unknown. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.last_seen: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), small meta text: when the Host last answered. {when} is a relative time from the formatter, like "2 hours ago".
host_down.status.reconnecting: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), quiet status line while the app is asking the Host again right now.
host_down.status.retry_in: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), quiet status line: when the app asks the Host again. {in} is a relative time from the formatter, like "in 30 seconds".
host_down.status.back_online: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), status line shown for two seconds when the Host answers again (adjective phrase, not a command).
host_down.read_only: Message field placeholder (hint text in the empty field) while the Host does not answer; saved messages stay readable. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.list_row: Chat list (and the Hosts list in Chat settings): one row above a Host's dimmed chats when it does not answer; tapping or clicking opens the Host-down panel. {when} as in host_down.last_seen. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.banner: App-wide banner at the top when this phone or computer has no network at all (statement, not a title).
host_down.action.retry: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): ask the Host again now.
host_down.action.check_tailscale: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): opens the Tailscale admin page to check this device is connected. Tailscale is a product name, never translated.
host_down.action.pair_again: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): sign this device in to the Host again with a new token.
host_down.action.edit_address: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): change the saved web address of the Host.
host_down.action.switch_host: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative): open another of the user's Hosts instead. Host stays untranslated.
host_down.copy_diagnostics: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), button (verb, imperative; "Copy" is the verb): copies a short technical text for support to the clipboard.
host_down.copied: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), toast (short confirmation) after the diagnostics text was copied (past participle).
host_down.details: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), label of a closed disclosure (noun, plural) that shows the raw technical detail of the last attempt.
host_down.close: Host-down dialog: accessibility label and tooltip of the close (×) button (verb, imperative).
host_down.token_or_link: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), placeholder of the token field under Pair again. "?token=" is literal, never translated.
host_down.token: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), placeholder of the token field under Pair again, for another saved Host (noun: an access token).
host_down.token_needed: Host-down panel (a Host that does not answer), error text under the token field when what was pasted is not a token. "clarp-admin url" is a command, never translated.
live.tool.exec.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while a shell command runs, followed by the command (present participle, "Running npm test").
live.tool.exec.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for a shell command, followed by the command (past tense, "Ran npm test").
live.tool.read.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent reads a file, followed by the file name (present participle).
live.tool.read.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for reading a file, followed by the file name (past tense of read, not present).
live.tool.list.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent lists a folder's files, followed by the folder (present participle).
live.tool.list.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for listing a folder, followed by the folder (past tense).
live.tool.search.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent searches files or code, followed by what it searches for (present participle).
live.tool.search.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for a search, followed by what was searched for (past tense).
live.tool.edit.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent edits a file, followed by the file name (present participle).
live.tool.edit.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for a file edit, followed by the file name (past tense).
live.tool.write.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent writes a file, followed by the file name (present participle).
live.tool.write.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for writing a file, followed by the file name (past tense).
live.tool.fetch.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent downloads a web page, followed by its address (present participle).
live.tool.fetch.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for a downloaded web page, followed by its address (past tense).
live.tool.todo.running: Chat, live turn: a tool row while the agent updates its step-by-step plan (present participle phrase; plan is a noun).
live.tool.todo.done: Chat, live turn: a finished tool row where the agent updated its step-by-step plan (past tense phrase; plan is a noun).
live.tool.mcp.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent calls an external tool (an MCP tool), followed by the tool's name (present participle).
live.tool.mcp.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for an external tool call, followed by the tool's name (past tense).
live.tool.agent.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row while the agent hands a task to a sub-agent, followed by the task (present participle).
live.tool.agent.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row where the agent handed a task to a sub-agent (past tense).
live.tool.other.running: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a tool row for any other tool while it runs, followed by the tool's name (present participle).
live.tool.other.done: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of a finished tool row for any other tool, followed by the tool's name (past tense).
live.exit_code: Chat, live turn: small tag on a failed shell command row giving the program's exit code. {code} is a number like 1 or 127 (technical; lowercase in English).
live.thinking_titled: Chat, live turn: one-line row while the model reasons, with the model's own short title of what it is thinking about. {title} is the model's words, never translated.
live.thought_for: Chat, live turn: one-line row after the model finished reasoning, how long it took. {time} is a duration from the formatter, like "4s" or "1m 5s".
live.thought_for_titled: Chat, live turn: as live.thought_for, followed by the model's own short title of what it thought about. {time} a duration like "4s"; {title} is the model's words, never translated.
live.exploring: Chat, live turn: one row grouping several reads, searches and listings while they run (present participle: the agent is looking around the code).
live.explored: Chat, live turn: one row grouping finished reads, searches and listings, when there is nothing to count (past tense).
live.explored_parts: Chat, live turn: one row grouping finished reads, searches and listings. {parts} is a list like "3 files, 2 searches" made of live.explored.* joined by live.list_separator.
live.explored.files: Chat, live turn: part of the explore summary (live.explored_parts): how many files the agent read (noun, plural by count).
live.explored.searches: Chat, live turn: part of the explore summary (live.explored_parts): how many searches the agent ran (noun, plural by count).
live.explored.listings: Chat, live turn: part of the explore summary (live.explored_parts): how many folder listings the agent made (noun, plural by count).
live.list_separator: Chat, live turn: the separator between the parts of the explore summary ("3 files, 2 searches"). Punctuation only; keep the trailing space where the language uses one (zh uses "、").
live.fold.worked_for: Chat: button above a finished turn that opens its folded tool calls; how long the agent worked. {time} is a duration like "11s" or "1m 5s".
live.fold.stopped_after: Chat: button above a turn the user interrupted that opens its folded tool calls. {time} is a duration like "12s".
live.fold.failed_after: Chat: button above a turn that failed that opens its folded tool calls. {time} is a duration like "12s".
live.fold.with_tools: Chat: the fold button's text when the turn used tools: {time} is live.fold.worked_for (or stopped/failed) and {tools} is live.fold.tools. Keep the middle dot.
live.fold.tools: Chat: part of the fold button (live.fold.with_tools): how many tool calls the turn made (noun, plural by count).
live.turn_failed: Chat: notice under a turn that failed when the Host gave no reason (a turn is one answer of the agent; noun + past tense verb).
live.status.thinking: Chat: status line above the message field while the model reasons, and the one-line thinking row (present participle, no object).
live.status.responding: Chat: status line above the message field while the agent writes its answer (present participle).
live.status.tool: Chat: status line above the message field while the agent runs a tool and nothing better is known (present participle).
live.status.compacting: Chat: status line above the message field while the agent shortens (compacts) its conversation context to fit the model (present participle).
live.status.waiting: Chat: status line above the message field when the agent waits for the user (an approval or answer).
live.status.background: Chat: status line above the message field while the agent's background jobs run (noun phrase).
live.status.limited: Chat: status line above the message field while the agent waits for its account's usage limit to reset.
live.show_it: Chat: tooltip of the status line's text, which scrolls to the row it names (verb, imperative).
live.interrupt: Chat: accessibility label of the stop button on the status line, which stops the agent's current turn (verb, imperative).
live.interrupt_tip: Chat: tooltip of the stop button on the status line (verb, imperative). Esc is the keyboard key, never translated.
live.more_lines: Chat, tool row: under a command's last output lines, how many more lines it printed (noun, plural by count; keep the +).
live.earlier_lines: Chat, tool row while a command runs: above its last output lines, how many lines came before (noun, plural by count; keep the +).
live.changed: Chat, live turn: verb at the start of the row summing up the turn's file changes, followed by how many files (past tense).
live.changed_files: Chat, live turn: after live.changed, how many files the turn changed (noun, plural by count).
live.compacting_context: Chat: divider line while the agent shortens (compacts) its conversation context to fit the model (present participle; ends with an ellipsis).
live.context_compacted: Chat: divider line after the agent shortened (compacted) its conversation context (past participle).
live.interrupted: Chat, tool row: small lowercase tag on a tool call that was cut off when the user stopped the turn (past participle, a status, not a command).
error.usage_limit: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code usage_limit: the account's usage window is spent). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.usage_limit_until: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code usage_limit: the account's usage window is spent). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated; {time} is a clock time from the formatter ("18:27", or with the weekday or date when not today).
error.billing: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code billing: credits, payment, a hard or monthly limit: no reset clears it). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.auth: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code auth: the sign-in ran out). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.account_plan: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code account_plan: the plan lacks the model). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated; {model} is a model name, never translated.
error.connection: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code connection: the link to the provider broke, retries used up). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.provider_busy: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code provider_busy: overloaded, rate limited, 429/5xx after the Host's own retries). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.provider_down: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code provider_down: the model's provider is unavailable). {model} is a model name, never translated.
error.invalid_request: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code invalid_request: the provider rejected the request as malformed (bad tool or call ids, an empty tool result, invalid payload, 400). Trying the same session again replays the same history, so the first action starts a fresh one). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.timeout: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code timeout: the backend stopped responding). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.runner_exit: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code runner_exit: the backend's process ended unexpectedly). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.folder_missing: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code folder_missing: the agent's folder is gone). {folder} is a folder path, never translated.
error.session_locked: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code session_locked: the backend's session is held by another process (a Codex thread with another active writer, a locked Grok session)). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.unknown: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code unknown: anything else). {backend} is the backend name (Claude, Codex, ...), never translated.
error.action.retry_at: Chat, failed-turn notice: button (verb, imperative): send it again at the given time, when the usage limit resets. {time} is a clock time from the formatter ("18:27", or with the weekday or date when not today).
error.repeat_count: Chat, failed-turn notice: small badge when the same failure repeated, how many times ({count} then a multiplication sign).
error.retry_scheduled: Chat, failed-turn notice: status after Try again at: when the message is sent again. {time} is a clock time from the formatter ("18:27", or with the weekday or date when not today).
error.free_model_restricted: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code free_model_restricted: an OpenCode free model refused outside OpenCode). OpenCode is a product name, never translated.
error.network_gone: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code network_gone: the computer had no network for 15 minutes).
error.refused: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code refused: the model refused (a safety filter blocked the answer)).
error.prompt_too_long: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code prompt_too_long: the conversation no longer fits the model).
error.ended_from_outside: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code ended_from_outside: a signal from outside the Host ended the turn). Clarp is the product name, never translated.
error.interrupted: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code interrupted: the turn was cut off before it finished (a restart, a process that went without a word)).
error.not_started: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code not_started: the Host could not start the turn).
error.folder_missing_no_path: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code folder_missing: the agent's folder is gone).
error.provider_mismatch: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code provider_mismatch: the agent ran on another provider than it is bound to). Codex is a product name, never translated.
error.moved: Chat: notice under a turn that failed, one plain sentence saying what happened and what to do (code moved: the agent moved to another Host).
error.action.retry: Chat, failed-turn notice: button (verb, imperative): send the same message again.
error.action.fresh_retry: Chat, failed-turn notice: button (verb, imperative): start a new session of the same conversation and send again.
error.action.compact_retry: Chat, failed-turn notice: button (verb, imperative): compact (shorten) the conversation, then continue.
error.action.switch_model: Chat, failed-turn notice: button (verb, imperative): pick another backend or model for this agent.
error.action.sign_in: Chat, failed-turn notice: button (verb, imperative): sign the backend account in again.
error.action.copy_details: Chat, failed-turn notice: button (verb, imperative); copies a short technical text for support ("Copy" is the verb).
error.details: Chat, failed-turn notice: label of a closed disclosure that shows the provider's raw words (noun, plural).
error.copied: Chat, failed-turn notice: toast after the diagnostics text was copied (past participle).
error.retry_sent: Chat, failed-turn notice: status after Try again: the message was sent again (past participle).
error.action_failed: Chat, failed-turn notice: status when one of its buttons did not work.
preview.own: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the user wrote it. {text} is the message line (words, or one of the preview.* lines). "You" is the user.
preview.image: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the message is one picture without a caption (noun).
preview.image_caption: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the message is one picture with a caption. {caption} is the picture's caption, never translated.
preview.images: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the message is several pictures (noun, plural by count).
preview.file: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the message is one file. {name} is the file name, never translated.
preview.files: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the message is several files (noun, plural by count).
preview.attachments: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the message is pictures and files together (noun, plural by count).
preview.code: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the message is only program code (noun).
preview.decision: Chat list: a chat's last-message line for a question card the user answered. {question} is the agent's question (user content); {outcome} is one of preview.decision.* or the chosen answer. Keep the middle dot.
preview.decision.approved: Chat list: how a question card ended, after its question: the user approved it (past participle, status).
preview.decision.declined: Chat list: how a question card ended, after its question: the user declined it (past participle, status).
preview.decision.discarded: Chat list: how a question card ended, after its question: the user discarded it without answering (past participle, status).
preview.decision.expired: Chat list: how a question card ended, after its question: it expired without an answer (past participle, status).
preview.decision.resolved: Chat list: how a question card ended, after its question, when nothing more specific is known (past participle, status).
preview.tool.exec: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last ran a shell command. {label} is the command, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.read: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last read a file. {label} is the file, never translated (past tense of read).
preview.tool.list: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last listed a folder. {label} is the folder, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.search: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last searched. {label} is what it searched for, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.edit: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last edited a file. {label} is the file, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.write: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last wrote a file. {label} is the file, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.fetch: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last downloaded a web page. {label} is its address, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.mcp: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last called an external (MCP) tool. {label} is the tool or its input, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.agent: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last handed a task to a sub-agent. {label} is the task, never translated (past tense).
preview.tool.todo: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last updated its step-by-step plan (past tense; plan is a noun).
preview.tool.other: Chat list: a chat's last-message line when the agent last used any other tool. {name} is the tool's name, never translated (past tense).
overview.no_messages: Agents overview (and quick switch): a chat card's last-message line when the chat has no messages, activity or folder to show.
overview.no_activity: Agents overview: a chat card's time of last activity when there has been none (in place of a relative time like "5 minutes ago").
overview.state.compacting: Agents overview: a chat card's small lowercase state word while the agent shortens (compacts) its conversation context (present participle).
overview.state.working: Agents overview: a chat card's small lowercase state word while the agent works (present participle).
overview.state.thinking: Agents overview: a chat card's small lowercase state word while the model reasons (present participle).
overview.state.responding: Agents overview: a chat card's small lowercase state word while the agent writes its answer (present participle).
overview.state.tool: Agents overview: a chat card's small lowercase state word while the agent runs a tool (noun; the agent is using a tool).
overview.state.new_reply: Agents overview: a chat card's small lowercase state word when the agent answered and the user has not read it (noun phrase).
overview.state.idle: Agents overview: a chat card's small lowercase state word when the agent is doing nothing (adjective).
overview.refresh_failed: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): error line at the top when the agent list could not be reloaded. "Computer" is the Host computer.
overview.agent: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card tag naming the backend, shown when the chat names none (noun).
overview.no_workspace: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card tag in place of the agent's folder when it has none.
overview.refreshed: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after the refresh button reloaded the agent list (past participle).
overview.action_failed: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): error line when a quick setting could not be changed. {action} is what was tried, like "Heartbeat on" (overview.heartbeat_on etc.).
overview.schedule_toggle_failed: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): error line when a scheduled task could not be switched on or off.
overview.schedule_enabled: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after a scheduled task was switched on (past participle).
overview.schedule_disabled: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after a scheduled task was switched off (past participle).
overview.release_failed: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): error line when releasing (ending) a chat failed (noun + past tense).
overview.released: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after a chat was released (ended and its agent freed). {name} is the agent's name, never translated (past participle).
overview.release_failed_long: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): error line when releasing (ending) a chat failed.
overview.title: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): the screen's title (heading) and its name for screen readers (noun, plural).
overview.conn.live: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): small status mark in the title row while connected to the Host (adjective: the connection is live).
overview.conn.connecting: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): small lowercase status mark in the title row while connecting to the Host (present participle).
overview.conn.dead: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): small lowercase status mark in the title row when the connection to the Host was lost (adjective: the connection is down).
overview.version: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): tooltip of the version badge: the Host's and this app's versions.
overview.fleet_map: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): accessibility label and tooltip of the icon link to the fleet map (a live map of all agents; noun).
overview.chat_settings: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): accessibility label and tooltip of the icon button that opens the Chat settings dialog (noun).
overview.automation_settings: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): accessibility label and tooltip of the icon button that opens the orchestrator (automatic routing) settings (noun).
overview.refresh: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): accessibility label and tooltip of the icon button that reloads the agent list (verb, imperative).
overview.close: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): accessibility label of the close (×) button of the screen (verb, imperative).
overview.summary: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): screen-reader name of the row of counts at the top (chats, working, needs attention, contacts; noun).
overview.chats: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): label under the chat count, the Chats tab and the Chats section heading (noun, plural: running conversations).
overview.working: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): label under the count of agents working now (adjective/participle).
overview.needs_attention: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): label under the count of chats with an unread reply or a status (verb phrase: these chats need the user).
overview.contacts: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): label under the contacts count, the Contacts tab and its section heading (noun, plural: saved agent identities ready for a new chat).
overview.search: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): screen-reader label of the search field (verb, imperative).
overview.search_placeholder: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): placeholder (hint text) of the search field: what it can search for.
overview.clear_search: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): accessibility label of the × in the search field, and the button under "No matching agents" (verb, imperative).
overview.sections: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): screen-reader name of the tab row (All / Chats / Contacts / Archive; noun).
overview.tab.all: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): tab: show chats and contacts together (adjective used as a noun).
overview.tab.archive: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): tab: show archived chats (noun: the archive, not the verb).
overview.dismiss: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): button that closes the error line (verb, imperative).
overview.n_working: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): beside the Chats section heading: how many agents are working now (participle, plural by count).
overview.current: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's status line for the chat open now. {state} is the card's state word (overview.state.*) or the agent's status text. Keep the middle dot.
overview.agent_context: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): screen-reader name of a chat card's tag row (backend, model, folder; noun).
overview.queued: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card tag: how many messages wait for the agent (participle, plural by count).
overview.push_muted: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card tag when push notifications for this chat are muted ("Push" means push notifications).
overview.context_tokens: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): tooltip of a chat card's context bar: how much of the model's context window the conversation uses. {used} and {total} are numbers (tokens are the model's units of text).
overview.context_percent: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's context bar label. {percent} is a percentage from the formatter, like "42%" (context: the model's conversation memory).
overview.open: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card button that opens the chat (verb, imperative).
overview.voice: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card button that opens the voice picker for the agent (noun: the agent's speaking voice).
overview.relaunch: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card button that restarts the agent with new settings (verb, imperative).
overview.less: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card button that closes its details (adverb: show less).
overview.details: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card button that opens its details (noun, plural).
overview.detail.session: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the session id row (noun).
overview.detail.backend: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the backend row (noun: the agent program such as Claude or Codex).
overview.detail.model: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the model row (noun: the AI model).
overview.detail.effort: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the reasoning effort row (noun: how hard the model thinks).
overview.detail.workspace: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the agent's folder row (noun).
overview.default: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: value of Model or Effort when none was chosen (noun/adjective: the default).
overview.none: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: value of the MCP row when the agent has no MCP servers (pronoun).
overview.quick_settings: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): screen-reader name of the row of switches in a chat card's details (noun).
overview.heartbeat: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the switch that has the agent wake up on its own regularly (noun, a feature name; translate descriptively).
overview.heartbeat_on: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after the heartbeat switch was turned on (status, not a command).
overview.heartbeat_off: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after the heartbeat switch was turned off (status, not a command).
overview.dreaming: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the switch that has the agent review its memory overnight (noun, a feature name; translate descriptively).
overview.dreaming_on: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after the dreaming switch was turned on (status, not a command).
overview.dreaming_off: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after the dreaming switch was turned off (status, not a command).
overview.push: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: label of the switch for this chat's push notifications (noun, plural).
overview.push_on: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after this chat's push notifications were turned on (status, not a command).
overview.push_off: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after this chat's push notifications were muted (status, past participle).
overview.schedules: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: heading of the agent's scheduled tasks (noun, plural; title case in English).
overview.on: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a scheduled task's switch while it is on (state, not a command).
overview.off: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a scheduled task's switch while it is off (state, not a command).
overview.archived_toast: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after a chat was archived. {name} is the agent's name, never translated (past participle).
overview.archive_chat: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: button that archives (hides) the chat (verb, imperative).
overview.release_confirm: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: question before releasing (ending) the chat, followed by Cancel and Release buttons.
overview.cancel: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: button that cancels releasing the chat (verb, imperative).
overview.release: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: button that confirms releasing (ending) the chat and freeing its agent (verb, imperative).
overview.release_chat: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a chat card's details: button that starts releasing (ending) the chat and freeing its agent (verb, imperative).
overview.builtin: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a contact card: small tag for a contact that comes with Clarp (adjective).
overview.saved: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a contact card: small tag for a contact the user saved (adjective/participle).
overview.start_with: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): accessibility label of a contact card's Start button. {name} is the contact's name, never translated (verb, imperative).
overview.start: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): a contact card button that starts a new chat with it (verb, imperative).
overview.archived: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): heading of the archived chats section (participle/adjective).
overview.restored: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): toast after an archived chat was restored. {name} is the agent's name, never translated (past participle).
overview.restore: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): an archived chat's button that brings it back (verb, imperative).
overview.no_matches: Agents overview (the full-screen Agents control surface): empty state when the search finds nothing.
